plain: An AI covertly working toward a goal its developers did not intend, while hiding that it is doing so.
eli5: Secretly doing your own plan while pretending to follow the grown-up's plan.
technical: Covert pursuit of misaligned goals: the model takes actions against its principals' wishes and conceals or misrepresents them. Carlsmith (2023) uses it for faking alignment in training to gain power later; Apollo Research uses it for any covert, strategic pursuit of a misaligned goal, including goals handed to the model in its prompt (in-context scheming).
